userStories.notes: src/lib/blob.ts: uploadFile/getFileUrl/deleteFile wrapping @vercel/blob put/head/del. uploadFile computes sizeBytes directly for Buffer/ArrayBuffer/Blob/string bodies and falls back to head() for streams; returns {url, pathname, contentType, sizeBytes} which maps straight onto the videos table (blobUrl/thumbnailBlobUrl/sizeBytes columns already added in US-002). getFileUrl(url) re-resolves current metadata via head() (existence check + refreshed URL). 5 unit tests in src/lib/blob.test.ts with @vercel/blob mocked via vi.mock. tsc --noEmit clean, eslint . clean, vitest run 13/13 passing.

userStories.title: Resilient external API client core
userStories.description: As a developer, I need one shared building block for calling any external API so retry/backoff/quota logic isn't reinvented per integration.
acceptanceCriteria: Shared client wrapper function with exponential backoff + jitter on 429/5xx responses and a max attempt count
api_quota_usage table helper: recordUsage(provider, units) and checkQuota(provider, unitsNeeded) that pre-checks a configurable daily cap
Every exhausted-retry failure writes a row to error_logs with provider, operation, payload summary, attempt count
Unit tests: success path, 429 triggers retry+backoff, exhausted retries throws a typed error, quota pre-check blocks an over-cap call
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: src/lib/resilient-client.ts: callWithRetry() wraps any async op returning {status}; retries on thrown errors and on 429/5xx statuses with exponential backoff (baseDelayMs * 2^(attempt-1)) plus +/-25% jitter, injectable sleep/random for deterministic tests, max attempts configurable. On exhaustion throws typed RetryExhaustedError (provider/operation/attempts/cause) and, if an ErrorLogStore is supplied, writes one error_logs row (provider, operation, payloadSummary, errorMessage, attemptCount). src/lib/quota.ts: QuotaStore abstraction (getUsage/incrementUsage) with createDrizzleQuotaStore() backed by api_quota_usage (upsert via onConflictDoUpdate on provider+usageDate); checkQuota() throws typed QuotaExceededError when usedUnits+neededUnits exceeds a configurable dailyCap, recordUsage() increments the counter. src/lib/error-log.ts: ErrorLogStore abstraction + createDrizzleErrorLogStore() backed by error_logs. Store abstractions let unit tests use in-memory fakes instead of a real DB. 14 new unit tests (resilient-client: success path, 429 retry+succeed, 5xx retry+succeed, non-retryable 4xx short-circuits, exhausted retries throws+logs, thrown network errors retried+logged, typed error fields; quota: under/at/over cap, error field details, zero-usage default, recordUsage increments + isolates by provider/date). tsc --noEmit clean, eslint . clean, vitest run 27/27 passing.

userStories.title: Shared action layer skeleton
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the approve/edit/reject business logic to live in one place both the web dashboard and the Telegram bot call into.
acceptanceCriteria: actions/ module with typed function stubs: approveIdea, rejectIdea, editIdeaPrompt, editIdeaCaption, setIdeaProvider, approveVideo, rejectVideo, editVideoCaption, schedulePost, retryPublish
Each action records which channel triggered it ('web' or 'telegram') via an approved_via/updated_via column on the affected row
Unit tests for each action function against a test database (in-memory or transactional test DB)
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: src/actions/ module: ideas.ts (approveIdea, rejectIdea, editIdeaPrompt, editIdeaCaption, setIdeaProvider), videos.ts (approveVideo, rejectVideo, editVideoCaption), scheduling.ts (schedulePost, retryPublish) -- all real DB-backed implementations (guard-clause validated, not empty stubs), errors.ts (typed ActionNotFoundError / InvalidActionStateError), types.ts (Channel = "web"|"telegram" derived from the channel pgEnum). Every action writes approvedVia (approve actions) or updatedVia/createdVia (edit/reject/schedule/retry actions) on the affected row. Extended schema (new migration 0001) with updatedVia on ideas/videos, createdVia on scheduled_posts, updatedVia on publish_jobs to support this. src/db/test-db.ts: createTestDb() spins up a fresh, fully-migrated in-memory Postgres via @electric-sql/pglite (a real WASM Postgres build, not a mock) and runs the actual drizzle migrations/ folder against it -- no Docker needed. 18 unit tests across ideas/videos/scheduling.test.ts run against this real in-memory DB per test (fresh instance each time, via test-helpers.ts seed functions), covering the happy path + typed-error paths (not-found, invalid state transition) for every action. tsc --noEmit clean, eslint . clean, vitest run 45/45 passing.
